items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Yeah, Uncle August was a kick.

ctx.x: That's right. Did you sing Navajo and My Little Napanee and all those songs? No. His uncles used to sing those, one of them, Uncle August. Yeah. And he was a kick, you know, playing in the backyard. They'd have a ball in the backyard. He's the backyard musician.
Yeah, Uncle August was a kick.
I used to do Mama Left Paw.
